A.depoimento: I ordered the production of two spearmen in Lisboa, increasing my garrison strength while preserving resources for future expansion. This buildup prepares me to seize the nearby neutral villages next turn.
A.plano: Build spearmen to boost numbers, then capture Santarem and Evora to gain extra production bases. Use the expanded economy to raise a larger mixed army and march along the road network toward the enemy capital Barcelona, overwhelming defenses with superior force.

B.depoimento: I trained one more archer in Barcelona and dispatched two archer squads each to Tarragona and Girona. My troops are marching along the roads to bring these neutral villages under my control. Capturing them will expand my realm and move me closer to victory.
B.plano: Next turn, I will check whether Tarragona and Girona have fallen and reinforce them if needed. I must keep a sufficient garrison in Barcelona to defend against any enemy advance. I will not send all my archers away, leaving the capital undefended.

two knights to Zaragoza,

Keep at least one defensive unit in each home village.

B.plano: Next turn, confirm Valencia capture and garrison survivors. Build more spearmen in Barcelona to replace marching units. Send reinforcements to secure Valencia and consider Teruel. Keep at least one defender in each home village.

A.depoimento: Our forces seized Santarem and Evora, neutralizing the nearby neutral threats and gaining two new villages for King A.
A.plano: Capture Santarem and Evora to secure the southern flank, then build up forces to push toward Coimbra and Badajoz, expanding toward the interior while preparing to challenge the enemy capital Barcelona.

Build more spearmen in Barcelona to replace marching units.

A.depoimento: I marched from Lisboa with two knights to take Coimbra and with two spearmen and one knight to seize Badajoz. Our southern front now holds five villages.
A.plano: Capture Coimbra and Badajoz to secure the southern flank, then reinforce them and build up forces to push toward Faro and Salamanca, preparing to advance on the enemy capital Barcelona.

B.depoimento: This turn I ordered spearmen production across all my villages and dispatched my two knights to seize Teruel and Madrid. I also sent spearmen from Castellon and Girona to bolster Valencia’s garrison for the upcoming push east.
B.plano: Next turn, expect to have taken Teruel and Madrid; reinforce Valencia with arriving spearmen; prepare to attack Murcia and Pamplona with spearmen; continue building spearmen; consider building knights after stockpiling.

B.depoimento: This turn I trained six knights across my realm and sent a force from Huesca to seize Pamplona. The attack should secure the village, expanding my holdings. No enemy movements were spotted.
B.plano: Next turn, expect to have captured Pamplona; Valencia will receive 4 spearmen reinforcements; use newly built knights to take Teruel and Madrid; continue knight production; consider adding archers for flexibility.

A.depoimento: This turn I ordered the construction of six additional spearmen in Lisboa, stockpiling the troops needed to overcome Faro's knight garrison. No troops were moved as we focus on building strength for the imminent assault.
A.plano: Build up spearman forces in Lisboa to launch a decisive strike on Faro next turn. After securing Faro, advance to Sevilha and Toledo to expand our southern front. Simultaneously, garrison interior villages and prepare archer reinforcements in Evora for future northern pushes.

B.depoimento: This turn I focused on fortifying my holdings, training spearmen in every village, and holding my armies in place. My marching columns advance on Pamplona, poised to seize it next turn.
B.plano: Next turn, expect to have captured Pamplona; Valencia will have 8 spearmen (4 built + 4 arriving); use spearmen to press Teruel or Murcia; continue spearmen production; consider building knights for offense.

A.depoimento:

Recruited spearmen in Lisboa and Santarem.
Sent spearmen reinforcements to Badajoz to prepare southern offensives.

Produce archers at Badajoz and knights at Coimbra.
Next turn, launch attacks on Faro and Sevilha with Badajoz forces, and take Salamanca and Toledo with Coimbra knights.

B.depoimento: We seized Murcia with a spearman charge, expanding our realm to nine villages. Six new knights were forged in Barcelona, Tarragona, and Girona, while spearmen swelled across our lands. The march toward victory continues.
B.plano: Next turn, fortify Murcia and prepare knight-heavy assaults on Teruel or Madrid; continue spearmen production; keep garrisons above 10 to deter raids; avoid attacking Burgos or Madrid without sufficient knights.

A.depoimento: This turn I fortified my armies: built a knight in Lisboa, five spearmen in Santarem, and knights in Coimbra and Badajoz. I reinforced Badajoz with spearmen, sent spearmen from Santarem to Coimbra for a future Porto strike, and dispatched Coimbra's knights to take Salamanca.
A.plano: Secure Salamanca with Coimbra knights next turn. Build up spearmen at Badajoz and Santarem to launch simultaneous attacks on Faro and Porto the following turn. After securing those fronts, advance knights to Toledo and spearmen to Sevilha. Consolidate gains and push toward unexplored territories.

A.depoimento: Built spearmen in all villages to stockpile forces. Sent 7 spearmen from Badajoz to seize Faro. Deployed a mixed force of 3 spearmen and 1 knight from Coimbra to take Porto.
A.plano: Capture Faro and Porto this turn to gain two key fronts. Reinforce Badajoz and Coimbra with newly built spearmen. Next turn, use Badajoz's spearmen to take Sevilha and Coimbra/Knights to hit Toledo, then push into unexplored territories.

B.depoimento:
Sent knight-heavy forces to seize Teruel, Madrid, and Burgos.
Reinforced barracks with new knights.
B.plano: Captured Teruel, Madrid, Burgos. Built knights in core villages. Next turn prepare to attack Cordoba and reinforce new villages.

A.depoimento: This turn we forge a knight in Badajoz, readying for the assault on Salamanca. Our holdings hold firm as we prepare to expand.
A.plano: Build a knight in Badajoz to strengthen our attack force. Next turn, use Badajoz's combined spearmen, archers, and knights to capture Salamanca, gaining an interior base. Thereafter, launch simultaneous pushes from Salamanca toward Madrid and from Porto toward Vigo, while reinforcing Badajoz to take Sevilha and Cordoba. Aim to secure 18 villages within three turns.

A.depoimento: I ordered a spearman in each village except Lisboa and Evora (where I built knights) and Badajoz (where I built a spearman and sent two of its knights to seize Salamanca). Our forces march to secure the first key neutral.
A.plano: Capture Salamanca this turn with knights from Badajoz. Next turn, reinforce Badajoz and aim to take Toledo with 3 knights. Then use Salamanca as a base to push toward Madrid via Zaragoza, while Porto and Coimbra seize Vigo and Sevilha with spearman masses. Goal: hold 18 villages within three turns.

B.depoimento:

Sent 1 spearman from Valencia to reinforce Zaragoza and 3 knights from Barcelona to seize Toledo.
Defenses strengthened.

Capture Burgos and Toledo while reinforcing Madrid and Zaragoza against enemy knight attacks.
Hold our current villages and prepare for next-turn advances.
No new builds this turn to conserve resources.

B.depoimento: We sent knights from Tarragona, Girona, Castellon, and Huesca to Madrid, and spearmen from Valencia to Zaragoza to strengthen our defenses. No new buildings were constructed. Our armies are en route to Burgos and Toledo, aiming to seize them next turn.
B.plano: No builds this turn to conserve resources. Reinforce Madrid and Zaragoza with incoming troops to defend against enemy knight attacks. Rely on existing marches to capture Burgos and Toledo next turn. Next turn, assess captured villages and consider building more troops.

A.depoimento: Ordered a full spearmen build in all villages to boost our army. Sent the Badajoz garrison to assault Toledo, expecting to seize the enemy village this turn.
A.plano: Build spearmen everywhere to mass infantry. Next turn use Badajoz to hold Toledo and launch attacks on Sevilha and Vigo with reinforced forces. Simultaneously strengthen Salamanca and Porto to threaten Madrid and neutral villages. Aim to capture at least two neutral villages per turn, reaching 18 held within four turns.

B.depoimento: This turn I trained spearmen in Barcelona, Tarragona, Castellon and archers in Valencia. I sent a mixed force from Madrid to take Burgos, a knight to seize Salamanca, and dispatched knights to strengthen Toledo's defenses.
B.plano: Next turn aim to capture Salamanca and Burgos; reinforce Toledo with arriving knights; assess new villages and consider further builds. Avoid overextending; keep Madrid and Toledo defended.

A.depoimento:
This turn I reinforced my borders with new spearmen and launched three assaults.
Faro sent eleven spearmen toward Sevilha, Porto dispatched seven spearmen and a knight to Vigo, and Toledo marched two spearmen, an archer and a knight against Teruel.
My interior villages swelled with fresh infantry to prepare for the next push.
A.plano:
Over the next turns I will consolidate the newly taken neutral villages, using them as bases to strike Cordoba and Madrid.
I will continue massing spearmen in my interior villages while converting excess wood into archers to counter spearmen garrisons.
My goal is to hold at least 18 villages within four turns by pushing both the western and central fronts.

B.depoimento: This turn I ordered mass archer production in Teruel, Madrid, and Murcia, and moved Valencia's archers to Teruel. These preparations will enable a triple offensive next turn to capture key enemy and neutral villages.
B.plano: Next turn attack Salamanca from Madrid, Toledo from Teruel, and Cordoba from Murcia using archer forces. Keep sufficient garrison to defend borders. Avoid sending more than available troops.

A.depoimento: This turn I built two spearmen in each of my interior villages to increase manpower. I sent reinforcements from Badajoz and Toledo to strengthen Salamanca, and from Evora to support the upcoming assault on Sevilha. I also launched an attack on Burgos from Vigo with spearmen and a knight, aiming to capture the weak enemy outpost.
A.plano: Over the next turns I will secure Burgos and Sevilha, using them as bases to threaten Cordoba and Madrid. I will reinforce Salamanca and Toledo with spearmen from Badajoz and Toledo to hold the central front. Meanwhile I will mass spearmen in interior villages and convert excess wood into archers to counter enemy spearmen garrisons. My aim is to reach 18 villages within four turns by taking Cordoba, Madrid and the remaining neutral villages.

B.depoimento: I sent mixed archer-knight squads to take Salamanca, Toledo, and Cordoba, securing three new villages. I also ordered production of archers and knights in my interior lands to replace losses. My front lines remain held with the troops left behind.
B.plano: Next turn, assess captured villages, reinforce garrisons, continue building archers and knights, prepare to attack Vigo or Badajoz if possible, avoid overextending borders.

B.depoimento: We sent Pamplona's force to Burgos and Toledo's force to Badajoz, aiming to capture both. We built new knights and archers across our interior villages to strengthen our armies. Our borders hold as we expand.

A.plano: Secure Badajoz as a foothold, then push east to take Toledo and Cordoba while reinforcing southern borders to hold gains.

Strengthening our front lines for future pushes.

A.plano: Capture Badajoz via Santarem to gain a strategic foothold, reinforce Salamanca and Vigo against incoming enemy armies, and produce spearmen in all villages to build up forces for further expansion.

A.plano: Build knights in Lisboa, Santarem, and Salamanca to mass a knight force. Next turn send them to Badajoz and Salamanca to prepare attacks on Toledo and Madrid. After securing those, advance to Zaragoza and Valencia.

B.plano: Hold Vigo, reinforce borders, continue building archers and knights, prepare to attack Salamanca or Sevilha next turn.

Capture these four enemy villages, then expand to the remaining foes.

Next turn, reinforce Porto and prepare attacks on Cordoba and Toledo with accumulated knights, while gathering spearmen in the south for an eventual strike on Madrid.
